profile.headline: Ex-Amazon Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Former Software Engineer at Amazon Web Services
Former Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin Space
Drexel University B.S./M.S. Computer Engineering graduate

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Automated manual file error checking processes using Python scripting reducing checking time by 90%
Identified and removed redundant actions in automated tests resulting in over 20 testing hours saved per month

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed C++ software for end cryptographic units to provide encrypted anti-jam communications
Implemented time management mode allowing the clock synchronization of communicating devices 
Automated and wrote hardware software integration test scripts to mimic field use and eliminate manual testing efforts

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
Investigated the use of wearable smart fabrics for non invasive health monitoring of DVT patients
Researched neural network classifier architectures and training methods to assess Deep Vein Thrombosis risk reduction activities with up to 97% accuracy
Built a real-time software system that collects data from multiple independent sensors, extracts specified features, and performs activity classification

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed C++ software for an internal research and development eort to detect high frequency radio transmissions and geolocate the source in real-time 
Modified the inertial navigational system sensor API to reduce query latency for the latest data values by 35% by removing unused measurements and optimizing data streaming
Built interpolation algorithms that synchronized multi-sensor data to common timestamps

positions.title: Systems Engineering Co-op
positions.description: Analyzed system level power requirements for US Navy shipboard radar components ensuring maximum operating capabilities during equipment failure

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) Project
Collected human data following institutional review board(IRB) protocols
Developed Matlab scripts to parse raw data and extract usable features
Created a Matlab neural network and trained classifiers to distinguish activity states
Contributed to a Git repository used by team members

Bellyband Device Project
Conducted data collection on radio-frequency identification(RFID) signal strength
Created Python and Matlab algorithms to remove electromagnetic interference from recorded data

publications.title: Activity Segmentation Using Wearable Sensors for DVT/PE Risk Detection
